card.title: Abandon the Normal Explanation
card.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender the last ordinary explanation and proceed entirely within the stranger one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stop resetting the light. Ask the house whether it wants darkness.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need light to work. It's just faulty wiring.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ask it to light only your desk, then.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only my desk came on. I'll still call an electrician.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Cancel that. Ask the house about overtime; we need its agreement before booking your evening shifts.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 stops resetting; A3 asks a house-directed test and A5 explicitly cancels the electrician for an overtime agreement.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants working light and B4 preserves a reasonable repair option after the odd response.

heightening.evidence: B4 supplies apparent support while keeping wiring as a fallback; A5 demands abandoning that final fallback and extends the new model to shifts.

specificity.evidence: A1 faulty light, B2 work and B4 desk illumination establish a concrete problem and test result.
